verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent exports: an Excel (.xlsx) file of ASC 718 stock-option expense calculations, the ability to export scenario models to review with your team, and a generic 'Standard reporting' line on the pricing page. Nothing documents exporting the actual cap table or the full transaction history. Missing for 10: documented export of the full cap table to Excel/CSV, export of the complete transaction/ledger history, confirmation that export is available at any time on all plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
